title: Medieval Castle
blurb: A fortress holding a mountain pass: a bridge across a gorge to an open gate, a walled courtyard, a stair to a wall ballista and an inner barricade. The same layout in Unity and in the browser, along the same 20-second camera path.
status: In progress. This is an earlier blockout pass, not final quality. A rebuild is underway and will replace it.
cardAlt: The Medieval Castle blockout from above: a crenellated gatehouse and walled courtyard beyond a long stone bridge over a gorge, with rounded hills and a few oaks.

videos.caption: Unity 6 with URP on Vulkan, as the project is configured: no anti-aliasing.
Holodeck's React Three Fiber viewer, captured with WebGPU. It also renders with WebGL2 when that is forced.

title: Firearms Through Time: Colt M4 at the range
blurb: A first-person range game whose rules run in two engines from shared fixtures. The same M4 sequence in Unreal and in the browser: aim, a semi round, a held 3-round burst, a short pull the cam remembers, inspect, reload, bursts until dry, and the empty reload.
status: In progress. Placeholder range art, test readouts still on screen in Unreal, and the reload is mostly below the view. Not playable on the site yet; the code is in the repository as an example.
cardAlt: Two first-person views of the Colt M4 aimed at a paper target on an indoor-style range: Unreal on the left, the browser on the right.

videos.caption: Unreal Engine 5.8 editor game, recorded during the automated M4 check run (57 checks passed). The on-screen text is that run's test readout.
Holodeck in Chromium on WebGPU, driven by a script with the same action order.
